messages:
Maria: quick heads-up, canary in eu-west failed during install. cosign verify OK but installer rejects signed bundle: 'signature expired'.
Samir: when was it signed?
Maria: packaging stamped bundle at 3929900000 but installer compares with now and TTL check fails. looks like signer TTL got tightened.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary deploy 1745619999 -> eu-west-1 failed: installer validation error (signature expiry). automatic rollback to stable-manifest@sha256:deadbeef triggered.
Kai: did we change signer defaults recently?
Maria: yes, signer-service default TTL flipped to 24h last week (was 7d). packaging pipeline still uses old assumption.
Julie: immediate actions: patch packager to set --signature-ttl=168h, regenerate canary, run canary with 15m hold at health-check. update release notes and ops runbook.
Samir: alternative quick mitigation: relax installer leeway by 5m for in-flight bundles? risky.
Kai: prefer re-signing rather than weakening validation. security should stay strict.
Maria: re-sign job started: `./ci/package-offline.sh --sign --signer=cosign --signature-ttl=168h`. ETA ~18m. ops-bot: packaging job #7291 queued by Maria. artifacts: s3://redwood-offline/canaries/1745619999.tar
Samir: monitoring checklist for canary: installer.unpack.errors, cosign.verify.latency, canary.healthcheck.failures, install.p95_time_ms.
Maria: found CI bug: packaging wrote timestamp in seconds but installer expected milliseconds. fixed in pipeline and added unit test.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary start: 1745619999-v2 -> eu-west-1; hold window 15m; notify @eng-oncall on anomalies.
Julie: rollback criteria: >5% node failures OR install p95 >250ms OR any cosign verify errors. Manual override allowed with `deploybot cancel` or `deploybot promote`.
Kai: note for release notes: explain signer TTL policy change and packager behavior (secs vs ms). I'll write the blurb and attach to the release PR.
Maria: new bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-offline/canaries/1745619999-v2.tar. installer log after first host: 'signature_ts=3929990200000; ttl=14515200; status=ok' (ms/sec alignment fixed).
ops-bot: reminder: pin stable manifest digest for fallback: `manifest@sha256:deadbeef...`.
Samir: once canary clears, we should add a CI gate ensuring packager TTL >= signer default.
Julie: agreed. adding to release checklist and tagging legal for change-log entry. :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks all, will follow up with PR links and screenshots of canary metrics.
